scope: Reusable cross-person measurement adaptation, not a model that identifies a known natal date

method_basis.name: Loewenstein 1996 Out of Control: Visceral Influences on Behavior
method_basis.claim: Drive states, e.g. sexual desire, can shift decision preference and attentional priority; not a diagnostic or natal property

method_basis.name: Ariely & Loewenstein 2006 Heat of the Moment
method_basis.claim: In male student experiment sexual arousal altered hypothetical judgments; not a personal inference or a universal effect size

method_basis.name: Duckworth et al. 2016 Situational Strategies for Self-Control
method_basis.claim: People can intentionally select or change situations to reduce temptations; a high impulse and deliberate avoidance are not contradictory

method_basis.name: Jovian Archive Splenic Authority
method_basis.claim: Quiet, momentary, nonrepeating awareness of immediate safety/appropriateness is the specific original source claim. Erotic appetite or an intense sustained pull is not by itself this signal.

classification_rules.name: Powerful attraction is not proof of HD Splenic decision guidance
Feeling good about someone is not a verified trustworthiness check
classification_rules.source: Loewenstein visceral/affective influences + no independently observed truth claim

classification_rules.name: Quiet momentary cue may be source-compatible only when both intensity and timing recorded
Sudden answer is distinct from sustained drive and from proof of HD source
